title: How to VLOOKUP with a partial match (contains)
task: Find a row when you only know part of the key — a fragment of a name, code, or title.

excel.note: Wildcards work in exact-match mode. XLOOKUP needs match_mode 2 for wildcards.

libreoffice.note: Identical (wildcards must be enabled in Calc options — they are by default for xlsx files).

explanation: Wrapping the fragment in asterisks turns it into a contains-pattern: "*Turing*" matches "Alan Turing" and returns 1912. The wildcards only fire in EXACT-match mode (FALSE) — the mode people think of as the strict one. First match wins when several rows contain the fragment; ~ escapes a literal * or ? in the data. In XLOOKUP the same needs match_mode 2, and case never matters.
